{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-q3hb","title":"[review] project-LICHEN-worker6-ghdn: Ack::from_bytes_for panics on 2-byte complete ACK messages","description":"## Bug
`Ack::write_to` at line 263 generates complete ACK messages as 2 bytes: `[rule_id, (window << 7) | 0x40]`.
However, `Ack::from_bytes_for` unconditionally accesses `data[2]` on line 307 without checking whether `data.len() >= 3`.

## Impact
Any call to `Ack::from_bytes()` on a 2-byte complete ACK message will **panic** with an index out of bounds. This includes the test at `fragmentation_vectors.rs:280` which exercises `ack_success_w0 = "7840"` and `ack_success_w1 = "78C0"`.

## Fix
`from_bytes_for` must handle the 2-byte complete ACK case before accessing `data[2]`. The complete ACK format is `[rule_id, (window << 7) | 0x40]` per `write_to` line 263. Parse the window from bit 7 (not `FRAGMENT_N`), detect the complete case, and return early with 2 bytes.","status":"open","priority":0,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"agent@lichen-project.dev","created_at":"2026-07-24T17:30:17.938587437Z","created_by":"AI Agent","updated_at":"2026-07-24T17:30:17.938587437Z"}
